sections.headline: Send every client report in 15 minutes, not 4 hours

sections.headline: Friday afternoons should not disappear into spreadsheets
body: You copy numbers from three tabs into a template, check them twice, and still get the one email that starts with 'this does not match what I see'.
Every client has a slightly different report, so nothing you build once gets reused.
